description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git mailmap functionality. It contains numerous test cases that verify how Git processes author and committer mappings, mailmap configurations, external mailmap files, and related settings.

methods.name: test_commit

methods.description: Initializes a new repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies Git configuration variables for testing.

methods.name: test_cmp
